title: Trone bi tukki ci saasi
intro: Ab nit ku am kiliftéef bu mag moo jiitewoon benn buur bu am xaalis bu bari alal ju ëpp. Bi njiit li amee jafe-jafe bumu xamul woon, dafa wara jànkoonte ak fitna, te mënul nekk fitna, waaye xam-xam ak ngëm lañu koy teg. Li xew mooy yóbbu nit ci coppite yu xóot ci xol.
clues: Maa ngi jiite woon réew mu bari alal ak naataange gu ëpp li kenn mëna xalaat
Buur bu am doole laa woon, ma jot bataaxal bu dëgër buy sàkku ñu topp
Samay njiit digal nañu ma ndax ma xeex wala ma jàmm ak buur bu sori bii
Ma dem ak kado yu rafet ngir daje ak buur bu sori bii
Sama jal bu buur yóbbu nañu ko ci réew mu sori ci diir bu gàtt, balaa may mëna dellusi
Bima duggee ci palaas bu dër bi nooy melni weer, ma mujjee wax ni damay topp Yàlla

arabic: فَلَمَّا جَآءَتْ قِيلَ أَهَـٰكَذَا عَرْشُكِ ۖ قَالَتْ كَأَنَّهُۥ هُوَ ۚ وَأُوتِينَا ٱلْعِلْمَ مِن قَبْلِهَا وَكُنَّا مُسْلِمِينَ
verse: So when she arrived, it was said [to her], "Is your throne like this?" She said, "[It is] as though it was it." [Solomon said], "And we were given knowledge before her, and we have been Muslims [in submission to Allāh]. (27:42)
